overview: At Beaconsfield you wrote the sentence about the horse. Earlier, on the ridge, a strap had wanted mending and the bay had its own views about the hill. That mend was already done. You did not open a new place for it. You wrote the one sentence and rode on.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote one sentence and shut the tables.

assets.name: the writing-tables
assets.disposition: Wrote that the horse governs the day
